description: Internal numbering rules counters allocations and normalized numbers; no seed
statements: CREATE TABLE numbering_rules (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,company_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,factory_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin,purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,scope_type VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(scope_type IN ('COMPANY','FACTORY')),code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,prefix VARCHAR(24) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,date_format VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(date_format IN ('NONE','YYYY','YYYYMM','YYYYMMDD')),sequence_width INT NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_width BETWEEN 3 AND 10),reset_period VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(reset_period IN ('NONE','YEAR','MONTH','DAY')),timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'DRAFT' CHECK(status IN ('DRAFT','ACTIVE','INACTIVE')),activated_at DATETIME(6),remark VARCHAR(2000),revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK(revision>0),created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),created_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,updated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),updated_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,UNIQUE(company_id,code),UNIQUE(id,company_id),FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),FOREIGN KEY(updated_by) REFERENCES users(id),CHECK((scope_type='COMPANY' AND factory_id IS NULL AND scope_key='C') OR (scope_type='FACTORY' AND factory_id IS NOT NULL AND scope_key=CONCAT('F:',factory_id))),INDEX(company_id,factory_id,status)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE numbering_counters (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,company_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,factory_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin,purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,reset_period VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(reset_period IN ('NONE','YEAR','MONTH','DAY')),period_key VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,current_value BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(current_value BETWEEN 0 AND 9999999999),UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,scope_key,reset_period,period_key),FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),INDEX(company_id,factory_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE number_allocations (id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin PRIMARY KEY,company_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,factory_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin,purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),scope_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,rule_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,request_key VARCHAR(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,fingerprint CHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,business_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL CHECK(business_type IN ('production-order','production-batch','product-serial-batch')),business_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,quantity INT NOT NULL CHECK(quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),numbering_date DATE NOT NULL,period_key VARCHAR(8) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,timezone VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,rule_snapshot JSON NOT NULL,created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6),created_by CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,request_key),UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,business_type,business_id),UNIQUE(id,company_id,purpose),FOREIGN KEY(rule_id,company_id) REFERENCES numbering_rules(id,company_id),FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES companies(id),FOREIGN KEY(factory_id,company_id) REFERENCES factories(id,company_id),FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users(id),INDEX(company_id,factory_id,created_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

CREATE TABLE number_allocation_items (allocation_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,company_id CHAR(36) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,purpose VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL CHECK(purpose IN ('MO','LOT','SN')),ordinal INT NOT NULL CHECK(ordinal BETWEEN 1 AND 1000),sequence_value BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK(sequence_value BETWEEN 1 AND 9999999999),number VARCHAR(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(allocation_id,ordinal),UNIQUE(company_id,purpose,number),FOREIGN KEY(allocation_id,company_id,purpose) REFERENCES number_allocations(id,company_id,purpose)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin
